title: AT-HYG v4.0 in 3D, by octree node

schema.name: ref
schema.note: bit 31 set: TYC1 << 17 | TYC2 << 3 | TYC3; else the AT-HYG id

schema.name: x
schema.note: in the node's cube, 0 to 65535 across it

schema.name: src
schema.note: bits 0-2 distance source, bits 3-4 magnitude source

partition.frame: ecliptic J2000, light-years, the Sun at 0
partition.rule: a node keeps the brightest (absolute V) of its cube; its children the rest

attribution: AT-HYG v4.0 by David Nash (astronexus), from Tycho-2, Hipparcos (ESA 1997), Gaia DR3 (ESA/Gaia/DPAC), the Yale Bright Star and Gliese-Jahreiss catalogues
